MAKING AMERICAN CHEESE AT HOME 🧀🍔 Today we are showing you how you can take any of your favourite cheese and turn them into a delicious meltable slice of cheese perfect for your burgers.  It’s easier than it seems, all it requires is good prep and a little bit of maths. Ingredients: - Cheese of choice (we used blue stilton and cheddar) - Water - Sodium Citrate Find Sodium Citrate in our Amazon List (link in bio) Taking the weight of your cheese you want 40% of the weight of cheese in water and 3% of the weight of cheese in sodium citrate.  So if your cheese weighs a total of 440g you need 176g of water and 13.2g of sodium citrate. Make sure you have your baking tray prepped and lined with a sheet of baking paper that has two edges over hanging.  Bring your water to a simmer and add in your sodium citrate, stirring until it is completely dissolved. Then add your cheese slowly, bit by bit, stirring as you go.  Once all of your cheese has been added and your sauce is a smooth consistency and starts to stick to the spoon you are ready. Take your cheese mix off the heat and pour into your tray, using a spatula or dough scraper spread it out until it is even and level then leave to cool before putting it in the fridge.  It will take at least 1-2 hours to set.  Once set remove from the fridge and cut to your desired shape and melt on your burger of choice! Crispy tortilla cones filled with juicy spiced beef and topped with melted mozzarella 🧀🔥 The perfect crunchy snack or quick dinner that everyone will love. One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #EasyRecipes #lazydinner #beefcones
